text: Binary check on OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; parse it; order irrelevant): returns 1 if every comment relies solely on abstract logical refutation of the OP's view (general reasoning, principles, definitions, logical structure) and no comment introduces a concrete external factual analogy or specific real-world case/example. Returns 0 if the list is nonempty and at least one comment introduces a concrete real-world analogy, case or example. Returns null if the list is empty, missing or malformed. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thanks/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred (generic delta/platform-rule discussion is allowed). Judge only from the supplied current text.
